title: Outrageously overpriced but necessary too for measuring the head space from the top of a jar when canning
text:
Outrageously overpriced but necessary too for measuring the head space from the top of a jar when canning. I purchased this for $8.20 plus tax on Amazon and even though it was cheaper than the current price of $9.89, I still feel this is outrageously expensive. I had to purchase it here because I could not find it at Walmart or Home Goods or anywhere else.

This plastic "wand" could not be more than five cents to produce. Nevertheless, it works to measure the head space needed from the top of the jar when canning and for that it is indispensable. I can also use it to remove the air bubbles in a jar but that can be done with a chopstick as well.
